response.overview: A video interview with Muller (who passed away a few years ago) about his own acting background, his early days in French cinema, his frequent casting in bad guy roles, his experiences watching audiences at his films, and thoughts on some of his key roles in various genres from swashbucklers to horror.  [From the Arrow Video "Gothic Fantastico - Four Italian Tales Of Terror" Blu-ray box set as bonus content for the film "Lady Morgan's Vengeance" (1965).]
response.tagline: An interview with actor Paul Muller
response.title: Born to Be A Villain
